## 2. Quarterly Breakdown

### Q4 2026 (Months 1–3): Non-Dilutive Grant Foundation & Compiler Hardening
- **Objective:** Establish Roche as the fastest, mathematically verified EVM fuzzer in the Ethereum ecosystem.
- **Milestones:**
  - Secure $500,000 EF ESP Trillion Dollar Security grant.
  - Ingest 100% of canonical EEST Cancun and Prague test vectors.
  - Publish `roche-rs` on crates.io and `hardhat-roche` on npm.
  - Zero heap allocation mechanical proof passing across all test suites.
- **Financial Status:** $500,000 non-dilutive grant capital secured.

### Q1 2027 (Months 4–6): Protocol Pilots & Multi-Chain Expansion
- **Objective:** Convert top DeFi protocols into active Roche CI users.
- **Milestones:**
  - Deploy Arbitrum Stylus and Optimism OP Stack invariant modules.
  - Onboard 10 major protocol teams (Uniswap V4 hooks, Balancer V3, Aave, Compound) onto 3-month free pilots.
  - Expand distributed AVX2 cluster throughput to 5,000,000 execs/sec across 16 bare-metal nodes.
  - Deliver final EF Grant milestones and submit Academic Whitepaper to top security symposiums.
- **Financial Status:** $600,000 additional L2 grants + $100,000 initial pilot conversions.

### Q2 2027 (Months 7–9): Enterprise Commercialization & White-Label Rollout
- **Objective:** Establish enterprise subscription revenue across top smart contract auditing firms.
- **Milestones:**
  - Launch Roche Enterprise SaaS ($3,000 / month / protocol).
  - Deploy white-label Roche Rust acceleration engine to 5 leading audit firms (e.g., Certora, OpenZeppelin, Spearbit, Trail of Bits).
  - Release Automated ZK Invariant Coprocessor for real-time ERC-4626 vault solvency proving.
- **Financial Status:** Reach **$600,000 Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)**.

### Q3 2027 (Months 10–12): Institutional Positioning & Strategic Liquidity
- **Objective:** Become the default state invariant and firewall standard across Ethereum L2 sequencers.
- **Milestones:**
  - Real-time mempool invariant firewall protecting $1B+ in total value locked.
  - Reach **$1,500,000+ ARR** across protocol security subscriptions and audit firm licenses.
  - Evaluate institutional acquisition offers (e.g., Paradigm, ConsenSys, Offchain Labs, Uniswap Labs) or initiate a **$10M Series A** round at a $60M+ valuation.
